entries.code_description: Sterile surgical catgut, similar sterile suture materials (including sterile absorbable surgical or dental yarns) and sterile tissue adhesives for surgical wound closure; sterile laminaria and sterile laminaria tents; sterile absorbable surgical or dental haemostatics; sterile surgical or dental adhesion barriers, whether or not absorbable
entries.comment:
Tabel I prov. a.8: bandages such as cottonwool, mesh, adhesives, band aids, tampons, splints and similar products for pharmaceutical purposes; first aid kits; sanitary napkins; maternity matrasses; incontinence products; products that with regard to use can be equated with said bandages and are developed and offered for medical purposes. 'Bandages' only encompasses products that serve to cover injured body parts. 
Excluded: consumer articles (such as clothing) which have a therapeutic effect.
